cases.name: Shafeqah Cooper
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Feqah, as her family called her, was an avid reader. She also enjoyed debating, shooting pool, writing poetry/ raps, music and football. She was die hard Cowboys fan and you could always get a good debate from her during football season. Shafeqah was also known for bringing home stray animals. Cats, dogs, or birds, it didn't matter, she loved them all. She was just a big old softly."
